LangChain CVE-2026-44967 (CVSS 8.8) drops Thursday-morning Pacific as a path-traversal in the workflow-state checkpoint loader's intermediate hand-off serializer, with v0.3.7 shipping same-day plus paired v0.2.x and v0.1.x backport advisories referenced by the NHS England blocklist. DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft co-publish a Thursday joint v3 addendum (arxiv 2605.06712v3) extending the runtime-verifier integration pattern to the intermediate-state-serializer with Python and Rust reference implementations covering all ten CVE-pattern instances. Verifiable Intermediate-State-Serializer Canonicalization for Agentic AI Workflow-State Migration (arxiv 2605.06892) ships Thursday with formal compositional safety theorems for the four-tier-and-sub-tier loader pattern, with INRIA France and Tokyo Institute of Technology added to the institutional reviewer cohort. vLLM v0.11.4-rc1 plus SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8 plus Hugging Face TGI v3.2.1 each ship the intermediate-state-serializer mitigation Thursday with vLLM additionally defaulting the signed-checkpoint loader and closing the parity gap to SGLang at 4.3 percent; Unsloth ships the matching mitigation as the first local-LLM fine-tuning stack to cover the four-tier-and-sub-tier surface; OpenAI Codex CLI v3.1.2 ships the matching client-side mitigation; Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, and AutoGen maintainer teams publish parallel Thursday commitments to ship the paired four-surface delivery as a default in the next minor-version release.
